programme.title: The Talented Mr. Ripley
programme.desc: To be young and carefree amid the blue waters and idyllic landscape of sun-drenched Italy in the late 1950s; that's la dolce vita Tom Ripley (Matt Damon) craves- and Dickie Greenleaf (Jude Law) leads. When Dickie's father asks Tom to bring his errant playboy son back home to America, Dickie and his beautiful expatriate girlfriend, Marge Sherwood (Gwyneth Paltrow), never suspect the dangerous extremes to which Ripley will go to make their lifestyle his own.

programme.title: The Godfather
programme.desc: Widely regarded as one of the greatest films of all time, this mob drama, based on Mario Puzo's novel of the same name, focuses on the powerful Italian-American crime family of Don Vito Corleone (Marlon Brando). When the don's youngest son, Michael (Al Pacino), reluctantly joins the Mafia, he becomes involved in the inevitable cycle of violence and betrayal. Although Michael tries to maintain a normal relationship with his wife, Kay (Diane Keaton), he is drawn deeper into the family business.

After pleading with her mother not to interfere, Samantha decides to tell her husband that he has unknowingly married a witch. To convince Darrin of her magic powers, Samantha performs a series of tricks. Darrin makes her promise never to practice her witchcraft again. Sheila, a former girl friend of Darrin's, invites the newly-weds to a dinner party. She makes every effort to embarrass Samantha before the guests. After enduring Sheila's snubs and insults, Samantha cannot resist evening the score. She employs her extraordinary powers to humiliate Sheila. Later, at home, Darrin rebukes his wife, but admits Sheila deserved the tricks played on her.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Samantha gives a dinner party to impress Rex Barker, one of Darrin's clients. Rex brings along his date, Babs Livingston, but advances on Samantha in the garden when he gets drunk.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Gladys Kravitz, a neighbor, is unable to convince her husband, Abner, that strange things seem to be happening at the Stephens' home. Gladys, June Foster, and Shirley Clyde, with their sons, visit the Stephens' home to welcome Samantha to the community. Gladys is frustrated in her attempts to point out to her friends the amazing number of objects which seem to appear and disappear. When the boys pester Endora, Samantha's mother, she uses magic to tie the three of them up. On leaving, Gladys tries to point out to her friends that it would be physically impossible for three boys to tie themselves up. Later Darrin returns home for his first meeting with Endora. Endora and Darrin soon engage in a heated argument about their opposing viewpoints on life. Endora threatens to turn Darrin into as artichoke. Later Samantha expresses her love for Darrin by announcing that if Endora had done so, she would also have turned herself into an artichoke.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Darrin discovers that Samantha has been entertaining a guest each morning after he leaves for work. the guest is ten year old Marshall Burns. Marshall's mother is a widow, whose over-protectiveness has robbed Marshall of all his self-confidence. Darrin tells Samantha that she has no right to interfere with Mrs. Burns' upbringing of her son. Despite Marshall's belief that he is no good at anything, Samantha takes him to a Junior League ball game. Marshall has never been able to make the team. Floyd Kravitz, nephew of Gladys Kravitz, is the star player. With a little witchery on Samantha's part, Marshall becomes a triple threat. When his mother, fearful that he may be inured, forbids him to play, Marshall runs away from home. Samantha and Darrin drive Mrs. Burns to the ball field. There, Marshall, in his own right, has continued to star. How-ever, when Marshall gets into a tight spot, Darrin forbids Samantha from interfering. Marshall makes it on his own. Proud of her son, Mrs. Burns is not unhappy when Coach Gribben suggests that he visit the Burns home to give Marshall some extra coaching.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Samantha, her friends, Bertha and Mary, and her Aunt Clara, all witches, decide to change the popular conception of witches into a more flattering image. Their opportunity arises when Darrin, an ad man, is assigned to devise a trademark for a new type of Halloween candy. Mr. Brinkman, the promoter of the candy, wants the trademark to show a traditional witch. Darrin at first agrees, but when he sees how upset Samantha becomes, he decides to present a beautiful witch. Mr. Brinkman objects, but Darrin refuses to yield. Con-sequently, he is fired. The witches decide to practice some of their pranks on Mr. Brinkman. As a topper, they transform him into an ugly old witch. Mr. Brinkman finally admits that his idea of witches is wrong. He agrees to use a glamorous witch for his trademark. Samantha wins her point, and Darrin wins back his job.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Teenager Liza Randall interviews Darrin about his career in advertising for a school newspaper. After Darrin takes Liza to the agency on Saturday, Liza's jealous boy friend, Marvin "Monster" Grogan, visits Samantha. Monster, a football star, wants to batter Darrin. Samantha, stuffing Monster with food, explains the innocence of Darrin and Lisa's relationship, although she knows Liza is more than interested in Darrin. At the office, Liza pours drinks. Liza and Darrin are doused when Darrin tries to take the drink away from her. Darrin escapes an awkward situation when boss Larry Tate arrives with two prospective clients . Meanwhile, Monster takes a romantic interest in Samantha. Darrin and Liza arrive, reeking of liquor. Darrin accuses Samantha of playing up to Monster. Samantha taunts him about Liza. However, when Monster winds up to clout Darrin, he bruises his hands on the invisible shield Samantha has created. When Liza slaps Darrin, however, Samantha lets him get the full force of the blow. Later Samantha removes her own protective shield when Darrin tries to make up.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Darrin's workload piles sky-high when Larry Tate and his wife Louise fly to Paris to cover the fashion showings- for a client. Samantha spends most of the time alone playing solitaire. She accepts Endora's invitation to fly to Paris, without a plane, of course, for lunch. In Paris, Samantha and Endora run into the Tates. Larry is surprised, phones Darrin that Samantha and her mother are in Paris with them. Samantha returns home immediately. Darrin tells Samantha their marriage is a mistake, since he has taken her away from all the high living she seems to love. Although Samantha tries to convinces Darrin that he is wrong, she angrily leaves, and returns to Paris. Larry Tate tells Darrin Samantha is lonesome for him. Darrin decides to follow her to Paris. After several unsuccessful tries, Samantha gets on Darrin's plane, and they arrive in Paris together.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Endora tells Samantha that Maurice, her father, is coming to visit. Endora warns Samantha that Maurice will be furious when he learns his daughter has married a mortal. Samantha, determined to stand up to her father, gets Darrin to stay in town on the night Maurice calls. Samantha tells Maurice that her husband is in Washington. The conversation about Darrin proceeds nicely until Maurice surmises Darrin is a mortal. Meanwhile, Darrin, who has been drinking with Larry Tate, phones Samantha and tells her he is coming home. When Darrin arrives, Maurice's fury hits its peak. Al-though Maurice admires Darrin's courage in facing up to him, he makes him disappear. Samantha, expressing her love for Darrin, pleads with Maurice to bring him back. Even Endora joins in Samantha's pleas. Although he tells them it will be extremely difficult, Maurice makes Darrin reappear. Before leaving, Maurice joins his family in a champagne toast. Im-pressed by the rare vintage, Maurice feels Darrin might be one of them after all.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: When Darrin starts searching for a "Miss Jasmine" for his firm's perfume account, Endora seizes the opportunity to sew doubt in Samantha's mind about her husband's loyalty. The search for a beautiful model ends when Jannine Fleur arrives. Both Larry and Darrin agree that Jannine is "Miss Jasmine." Samantha learns that Jannine is a witch whom Endora has asked to captivate Darrin. Samantha warns Jannine to keel away from Darrin. Jannine, intrigued, keeps on with her original assign-ment. Darrin uses Larry Tate as his chaperone to keep him from becoming involved with Jannine. Darrin and Larry go to Jannine's apartment to discuss details of the "Miss Jasmine" campaign. Jannine doctors the drinks. Larry falls asleep and Darrin becomes amorous. Just as Darrin starts to kiss Jannine, Samantha uses her witchcraft, and Darrin appears to Jannine as a large ugly fish. When the campaign is completed, Samantha turns the picture of "Miss Jasmine" into a caricature of Jannine.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Larry and Louise Tate have been married for sixteen years and have no children. Louise asks Samantha to go with her to an obstetrician as tests have shown she is going to be a mother. Louise tells Samantha she is afraid to tell Larry since she believes he hates children. Larry, visiting his dentist at the medical center, sees Louise and Samantha enter the obstetrician's office. Thinking Samantha is going to have a baby, he tells Darrin, but cautions him not to say anything until Samantha tells him. In a reverie, Darrin visualizes his children as little witches. He comes to with a sinking feeling. Samantha invites the Tates to dinner. Both Larry and Darrin hover over Samantha, warning her not to exert herself. Louise is all but forgotten, but makes several unsuccessful attempts to tell Larry that he is to be a father. Finally, Samantha tells Larry. He is overjoyed. Although Darrin doesn't tell Samantha about his reverie, he is reassured when she tells him she hopes they have a child who looks just like him.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Samantha's friend, Gertrude, a nice, plain-looking girl expresses her envy of the happiness Samantha has found in marriage. Although Darrin tries to avoid getting mixed up in matchmaking, Samantha persuades him to bring Kermit, a handsome artist, home to dinner to meet Gertrude. Kermit falls for Gertrude. Although Samantha will mot admit it, Darrin suspects Gertrude is a witch and tries to break up her romance with Kermit. Darrin arranges a meeting at a nightspot for Kermit with Susan, a former girl friend. There, Samantha uses witchcraft to get Susan into an argument with Kermit. Susan storms out, unable to recall what has happened. When Gertrude arrives, according to Samantha's plan, Kermit proposes to her.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Darrin's parents pay their first visit to the Stephens home, Darrin's mother, Phyllis, hopes to find that his wife is a poor housekeeper. Soon after, Samantha's Aunt Clara comes down the chimney for an unexpected visit. Darrin is worried about the kind of impression Aunt Clara will make on his parents, but agrees with Samantha that they must make Aunt Clara feel welcome. Determined to help Samantha make a hit with her in-laws, Aunt Clara uses her witchcraft to whip up a feast for dinner. Thinking that Samantha has done the cooking, Phyllis becomes quite upset. Although Samantha warns him to be tactful, Darrin makes Aunt Clara feel she is not wanted. After Aunt Clara's de-parture, Samantha gets into an argument with Darrin, during which Phyllis learns Aunt Clara cooked the dinner. When Samantha admits she is not a good housekeeper, Phyllis, who felt she was being pushed aside, knows she is going to love her daughter-in-law. Darrin persuades Aunt Clare to return and the evening ends happily for all.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: Martyna Wojciechowska once again sets out on a fascinating journey to learn about different aspects of the lives of women living in distant corners of the world.Some of the points of the route in this edition will be India, Senegal, South Korea, South Africa, Israel and Mexico.The program participants will talk about their everyday lives and reveal intimate secrets to the traveler.Some of them will be truly moving.This season, the journalist will look at how the Orthodox Jewish community functions on a daily basis and how they celebrate the joyful holiday of Purim.He will visit a nursing home for women who were once involved in prostitution.Although this profession is legal in Mexico, women are not entitled to any benefits.The traveler will also meet teenage Karolina, who works almost 24 hours a day at a garbage dump, and in South Africa she will meet a girl who dives with sharks.These are just some of the many amazing experiences that await Martyna Wojciechowska Martyna Wojciechowska visits Lebanon to meet Ghada.In Syria she was involved in teaching.She hid from her husband and in-laws that she was studying, because in this country women's independence is not welcome.After the outbreak of the war, she became a social activist for representatives of her gender and children.He has been living in Lebanon for four years.He is already building a second school for young Syrians there.Her students had to leave their homeland before the war.Ghada founded the Damma organization and helps women find their way in new realities.Most of them support their families on their own.They also need integration and joint action.The heroine of the episode teaches Syrian women independence and gives them hope for a better tomorrow.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: Martyna Wojciechowska once again sets out on a fascinating journey to learn about different aspects of the lives of women living in distant corners of the world.Some of the points of the route in this edition will be India, Senegal, South Korea, South Africa, Israel and Mexico.The program participants will talk about their everyday lives and reveal intimate secrets to the traveler.Some of them will be truly moving.This season, the journalist will look at how the Orthodox Jewish community functions on a daily basis and how they celebrate the joyful holiday of Purim.He will visit a nursing home for women who were once involved in prostitution.Although this profession is legal in Mexico, women are not entitled to any benefits.The traveler will also meet teenage Karolina, who works almost 24 hours a day at a garbage dump, and in South Africa she will meet a girl who dives with sharks.These are just some of the many amazing experiences that await Martyna Wojciechowska.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: On August 4, 2020, a powerful explosion occurred in the capital of Lebanon, Beirut.Almost 200 people died, thousands were injured, and 300,000 city residents lost their homes.The tragedy was caused by the explosion of 2,750 tons of domestic saltpeter, previously confiscated and stored in the port.A small Middle Eastern country - which has been struggling for years with the economic crisis, corruption, poverty and unemployment, and the problem of Syrian refugees - was unable to cope with the enormity of the destruction left after the explosion.The whole world supported him, but many months passed before the city was rebuilt.One of the people who supported the injured was volunteer Zena Chahine.She is the first woman in the ranks of the Lebanese volunteer fire brigade.Following her example, dozens of other brave ladies entered the service.To this day, ignoring the danger, he does everything to rebuild his beloved city.

programme.title: Asian Times
programme.desc: Julian Hanton visits Asia.It checks what changes are taking place on the continent, where economic recovery goes hand in hand with population growth.The leader begins his journey in Hong Kong, where he inadvertently agrees to take a punch from Bruce Lee.This experience will be remembered for a long time.In Thailand, he makes friends with investigative journalists, becomes a secret agent and monitors local gambling.In the Philippines, Vietnam, Malaysia, Indonesia and China, he carefully observes people and their behavior.He discovers that all corners of the world are an inexhaustible source of knowledge.

programme.title: The Extraordinary States of Procopius
programme.desc: Marcin Prokop will go on a spontaneous journey around America in a program full of humor.During his journey across the United States, which lasts over a month, the journalist will cover thousands of kilometers.Viewers will have the opportunity to see the alleys of the largest Chinese district in the US, find themselves behind the walls of the most famous prison, Alcatraz, and look out the window of the tallest skyscraper in San Francisco.The host will stop at the world's largest stop for giant trucks, visit a hippie town and visit a unique restaurant connected to a laundry.The audience will be able to feast their eyes on amazing landscapes, unique national parks and wonderful waterfalls In the final episode, the creators of the program will visit Sioux Falls, the largest city in the state of South Dakota, whose most popular attraction are waterfalls.Marcin Prokop will assess whether it is worth going there.Then he will go to a creepy town, inspired by the Westworld series, inhabited by realistic-looking mannequins.The last point of Marcin Prokop's journey is Chicago.There he will visit the Polish district, see a fountain with many faces, and take a look at the largest bean in the world - Cloud Gate.In this episode, viewers will have the opportunity to follow the host's mishaps and find out what happened behind the scenes of the program.

programme.desc: For the first time, the race will take participants through Africa.They will cover the route through Kenya and Tanzania - from the foot of Kilimanjaro, through the crowded streets of Arusha, to the sand dunes by the Indian Ocean and historic Mombasa, ending the competition in Nairobi.Eight couples: Ewa Gawryluk-Domaniecka with her husband Piotr Domaniecki, Edyta Zając with her partner Michał Mikołajczak, Nikodem Rozbicki with her friend Paweł Kurkowski, Wiktoria Gąsiewska with her brother Mateusz Gąsiewski, Tomasz Iwan with her partner Karolina Woźniak, Katarzyna Niezgoda with her husband Paweł Markiewicz, Izu Ugonoh with his wife Antonina Ugonoh and MonikaHoffman-Piszora, together with her sister Iga Hoffman, faces the challenges of harsh, unpredictable nature - lack of roads, difficult access to water and communication, time pressure and their own emotions.The program will be hosted by Iza Krzan.Every day, participants must demonstrate perseverance, cooperation and resilience, learning about completely different faces of Africa.It's a test of boundaries and a lesson in friendship Participants go to Vibanda Village, where an unusual challenge awaits them: "7 Monsters", i.e. a roulette of flavors.Each pair spins the wheel three times and must eat the selected local dishes until the end.Then the competition moves to the Kenya Railway Museum, where you have to arrange ten photos from different stages of the race.Another obstacle is field assignments in Nairobi.Participants go to designated places where they solve numerical puzzles that require perceptiveness and reflexes.In the finale, the couples travel through various corners of the city, visiting, among others:a hairdressing salon or a giraffe shelter.Only the fastest and most persistent have a chance to reach the finish line, located on the roof of the Kenya International Convention Center.

programme.title: It's beautiful here
programme.desc: Dorota Szelągowska will visit unique places in Poland, the existence of which only insiders often know.The host will prove that it is never too late to fulfill your childhood dream and live in a tree house, at least for a while.For those who value greater comfort, he will show luxurious interiors created, among others, by:in an old cotton fabric factory.Viewers will also meet the owners of these charming places, who will tell their stories and reveal how they managed to implement their unique plans and projects.Many of them abandoned life in big cities to be able to do what they love most, i.e. interior design and running unique guesthouses.Dorota Szelągowska will look into every nook and cranny of these original buildings, reveal interior design ideas to viewers and prove that there are many wonderful places in Poland that are truly beautiful.

programme.title: Taste the world with Pascal
programme.desc: Pascal Brodnicki likes to explore the world through his sense of taste.He loves to prepare various dishes at street stalls, in African villages or on the beach. However, during his culinary journeys it was not always easy for him.Sometimes elephants stole his ingredients.Of course, Pascal couldn't deny himself the pleasure of tasting local delicacies.In Delhi, he stopped for a long time at a paratha stand, in a Zanzibar village he ate rice with coconut, and in Namibia he tried a zebra steak."Taste the world with Pascal" is not only about cooking.The host visited an elephant orphanage in Sri Lanka, fed cheetahs in Africa and climbed a coconut tree.In Bombay he became a teacher and taught Polish to children, and on the coast of Zanzibar he hunted octopus.Everywhere his passion and positive energy attracted crowds of onlookers This time Pascal went to Namibia, famous for its cow breeding and delicious beef.The chef grills his favorite steaks here and, as usual, he will do it in an unusual place.This time on the farm where they are kept.tamed cheetahs.After meeting the big cats, Pascal sets off north of the country, to Opuwo, where he goes to a supermarket.Here he meets half-naked women from the Himba tribe who are shopping.He also visits the market where he buys a gift for the Herrero tribe - a goat.His gesture wins great acclaim and Pascal is welcomed into the village with an amazing dance.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: Martyna Wojciechowska visits Mongolia.There, in the inaccessible mountain areas of Altai, the Kazakh minority lives.They are cut off from their roots, but they maintain traditions from 3,000 years ago.The traveler meets a fourteen-year-old girl with strength and courage greater than many men.Petite, charming Akhbota practices falconry every day after school.It's hard to believe that such a delicate girl can communicate with a predatory bird weighing eight kilograms and whose wingspan reaches up to two meters.Martyna Wojciechowska tells a story about true strength, courage and the bond between man and animal.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: Martyna Wojciechowska is visiting Japan.He decides to meet the doll woman.So she goes to Tokyo, where she meets a man who is in love with Megumi.Practical Japanese people increasingly replace true love in this way.They even marry artificial women.According to estimates, there are as many as twenty thousand men in the Land of the Rising Sun who have such a doll.Their size, weight and appearance reflect humans.The traveler is looking for answers to the questions whether it is possible to fall in love with a doll and whether it is an image of the future.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: This time, Martyna Wojciechowska moves not only in space, but also in time.He goes to a place that is only thirty kilometers from Santa Cruz - one of the largest, most populated cities in Bolivia.The traveler visits Mennonites living in harsh and wild rural communities.They consciously reject electricity and modern technology.They devote themselves to religion, farming and animal husbandry.They don't do any sports, they don't have access to TV or phones because all of this is prohibited.Their education ends with basic knowledge of arithmetic and the study of the Bible.Viewers will see how Martyna Wojciechowska finds herself in this extraordinary world.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: Martyna Wojciechowska visits an extraordinary beauty salon located in Lahore, Pakistan.His services are used by women who have suffered acid burns in the past.Dousing and arson attacks affect up to several thousand women every year.A bottle of acid does not cost even a zloty, the substance is easily available, and the attack lasts a few seconds.The traveler talks to Musarrat Misbah, who has already helped over five hundred injured women.It provides victims with proper medical care, reconstructive surgery, psychological care and employment.He gives them jobs in his salon.Viewers will see what the life of the so-calledfaceless women.
